annotations.title: Make a post about a product

description: Turns product links into a draft post in one go. Each link is saved (or reused) with what earns on it: your Amazon Associates tag, or a joined brand program's code. in_post puts {link} in the caption, and each network gets its own words for it: the link where captions take one (the pin's link on Pinterest), "Comment WORD" on Instagram with keyword (an auto-reply DMs the link), and "Link in bio" on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram without one. on_bio puts the products on the link page, the post's Shop the post tile once it's out, and a collection. An earning post gets #CommissionsEarned (Amazon) or #ad. The post uses the creator's own photo or video: without media_ids it waits (needs media). story adds a Story reminder with the link sticker once it's out on Instagram. Then voice_get and post_update for the brand's voice (keep {link}), media if needed, post_submit. Undo takes back the post, new links, the auto-reply and the page change.

account_ids.description: Accounts from accounts_list. Left out: the ones the workspace posts to lately

caption.description: Your own words; {link} is added where you leave it out (in_post), and a disclosure when it earns. Left out: the product's name, {link} and the disclosure

collection_id.description: A collection from bio_collections_list to put the products in

collection_title.description: Or a collection by title, made when there's none

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

keyword.description: With in_post, a word people comment on Instagram to get the link in a DM ("Comment SKILLET"). Its auto-reply is made with the post on each Instagram account, or one already sending the same link is used again; needs the comments and dm permissions

kind.description: Left out: carousel for several pictures, image for one, reel or video for a video

media_ids.description: The creator's own photos or videos (media_list). Left out: the post waits for one (needs media), or goes as text where every account takes text

on_bio.description: The products on the link page and the post's Shop the post tile

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601. With an offset (2026-11-02T09:00:00-05:00) it is that moment; without one (2026-11-02T09:00) it is that clock time in the post's time zone (timezone, else the workspace's), so daylight saving is handled for you.

story.description: Once it's out on Instagram, a Story to post yourself with a link sticker (the API can't add one): the team gets a reminder with the link to paste

submit.description: Send it for approval when nothing's missing

url.description: A product's page: Amazon, a brand's shop, anywhere

urls.description: Or several, for one post with up to 10 products

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
